name: The Treehouse Hardwoods & Mill Shop
old_description: Great pieces of miscellaneous Hardwoods for your DIY Projects!
about:
The Treehouse Hardwoods & Mill Shop was established in 1966 in South Burlington, Vermont. The business is operated by a team of woodworkers including Lucas, Carl, Jeremy, Adam, Tim, Sherb, John, and Jude, who together bring nearly 60 years of experience in buying, selling, and working with wood.

The company maintains a large inventory of domestic and exotic hardwoods, live-edge slabs sourced from Vermont, New Hampshire, and New York, hardwood plywood, and specialty items such as burls and "Hard Maple Cookies." Its millshop provides custom milling services including planing up to 24 inches, wide-belt sanding up to 42 inches, resawing up to 16 inches, CNC milling, and reproduction of antique moldings, car parts, and boat parts. The shop also produces butcher-block tops, table and counter tops, stair components, and custom sawn veneer. General shop rates are $85 per hour with a $50 minimum; specialty work runs $120 per hour with a $60 minimum.

Customers range from professional woodworkers and hobbyists to homeowners, builders, and contractors. The millshop handles small-to-medium projects, including new construction, remodeling, and historic building restoration.

The company distinguishes itself by combining a broad retail selection — described as the largest variety of hardwood plywood in northern Vermont — with a job-shop capable of custom reproduction work, all while emphasizing personal advice and service for projects of any skill level.
